pages.title: Lowland Tapir
pages.text: The lowland tapir ($(o)Tapirus terrestris$()), or South American tapir, is a tapir found in the rainforests, wetlands and grasslands of South America.$(br2)It is the largest native land mammal of the Amazon. Like all tapirs, it has a short prehensile snout used to grasp leaves and fruit.$(br2)Lowland tapirs are strong swimmers and often take to water to escape predators. The species is listed as Vulnerable.
